page.overview:
Who is Freyja Marten?

Freyja Marten (who commonly goes by her flight call FM) is a character in the Skyward series and the main character in her own novella Sunreach. FM was one of the original member of the Skyward flight crew, and one of only two people to have officially finished flight training.

FM chose her callsign since she was thrilled to find that the initials of her name was the name of a radio broadcasting that could share music with the entire world at all times. FM was raised to not buy into the DDF ideals, and takes up every opportunity she can to be rebellious against it. She has taken it upon herself to be known as a Disputer, or member of a movement against the DDF for becoming to much of a dictatorship, and praising people for the wrong things. She often complains about how her flight crew is too aggressive, and is quick to identify any hypocrisy. FM guiltily helps the DDF fight off the Krell and encouraging their aggressive militaristic ways.

FM wears her emotions on her sleeve, is rather perceptive, and good at reading others. She is highly confident and unafraid to speak her mind, nor is she opposed to skirting or breaking the rules. This confidence, along with her refined and poised manner, makes FM appear older than the rest of her flight. She can be a perfectionist and dislikes her own shortcomings, even when she is doing better than her classmates. FM is more conservative when presented with risky choices, choosing to take the safer option. She may do this as a statement against the strong risk taking attitude promoted by the DDF.

FM is tall and slender, measuring up to be 185 CM (6 FT, 1 IN) tall. As a result of her rich family she is known to wear nice clothing, managing to look fashionable in even a flight jumpsuit. When she is off flight duty she can be found wearing blouses and skirts. FM has blond hair she keeps short, being unable to grow it to her shoulders without it bothering her. She has Northern European Heritage hence she was named after the Norse goddess of love and beauty Freyja.
